{"type":"chore","title":"ci(shell-tests): run shell harnesses in parallel to cut CI wall time","commit_subject":"ci(shell-tests): collapse serial harness steps into parallel runner","summary_md":"## Summary\n- Adds `bin/run-shell-harnesses`, a new script that runs all shell test harnesses in parallel using `xargs -P`, prints each script's output in a collapsible `::group::` block, and fails if any harness fails.\n- Collapses ~85 sequential `run: bin/test-*` steps in `tests.yml` into one step that calls `bin/run-shell-harnesses` with the full list. `bin/test-burndown` keeps its own isolated step because it requires a scrubbed environment.\n- Updates the CI-wiring assertions in `bin/test-digest-dm-build` and `bin/test-pr-cycle` to match the new single-step layout (grep for the script name on its own line rather than a `run:` prefix)."}
